UI_NW_options_pack_vanilla_tooltip: The 91 symbols Project Zomboid ships with.
UI_NW_options_pack_extra_tooltip: 46 hand-drawn symbols bundled with this mod, from ExtraMapSymbols.
UI_NW_options_pack_amms_tooltip: 95 more symbols bundled with this mod, from Add More Map Symbols: vehicles, tools, weapons and furniture. Off by default because it triples the size of the sheet.
UI_NW_options_pause_tooltip: The world stops while a sheet or a paper map is open. Turn it off to keep the game running - on a server, or to write with the world still moving around you.
UI_NW_options_vanilla_map: Leave the map to the game
UI_NW_options_vanilla_map_tooltip: The world map and paper maps open with the game's own panels, buttons and sharing, exactly as if this mod were not installed. The bundled symbol packs stay. Writing on paper is not affected. For servers built around the vanilla map.
UI_NW_options_map_nopause: Keep the world running on the world map
UI_NW_options_map_nopause_tooltip: Opening the world map does not pause the game in single player, so your character can keep walking while you read the map. Off, the game's own option decides, as before.
UI_NW_options_share_tooltip: In multiplayer, lets you choose who each new symbol, note and stroke is written for - your faction, your safehouse, chosen players, everyone. Turn it off and the sharing button disappears: nothing you write leaves your own map. Single player is not affected.
UI_NW_options_page_limit_tooltip: The most you can write on one page. A counter appears under the text while you write. On a server the sandbox setting decides for everyone.
UI_NW_options_place_adjust_tooltip: While you hold a symbol or write a note on the map, Ctrl + mouse wheel changes its size and Shift + mouse wheel turns it, before it is placed. The wheel alone still zooms the map.
